user.title: Add a Hearth device
user.description: Enter the device's host and port. The app serves one integration session at a time (newest wins): migrate from VACA per device by deleting its VACA entry first.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Add a Hearth device
zeroconf_confirm.description: Add {name} to Home Assistant? The app serves one integration session at a time (newest wins); if this device still has a VACA entry, delete it first.

toast.name: Show toast
toast.description: Shows a short on-screen message on the Hearth device.
